claims.source_quote_ar: صرف الكلام عن الخطاب إلى الغيبة
claims.claim_ar: صرف الكلام عن الخطاب إلى الغيبة (التبديل من المخاطب إلى الحديث عنه) لتحقيق المبالغة والتقبيح
claims.claim_en: A shift of speech from direct address to speaking about them in the third person (iltifat), used to amplify and elicit reproach/condemnation
claims.rhetorical_effect: creates emotional distance and intensifies blame by describing the addressees as if they are being observed and judged, provoking condemnation from listeners/readers

claims.claim_ar: الواو هنا استئنافية في افتتاح الظرف (وَيَوْمَ) لتعريف الزمان والاستئناف في السرد
claims.claim_en: The conjunction waw functions as an 'isti'naaf' (resumptive/introductory waw) with the temporal adverb (يَوْمَ), marking the temporal setting and resumption of narrative
claims.needs_review_reason: The commentary labels the conjunction (الواو) rather than the noun itself; association to word_index 1 (يَوْمَ) may need verification
claims.rhetorical_effect: frames the forthcoming scene in time, lending solemnity and continuity to the narrative moment
